character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every scene: dark auburn curls beneath a sapphire scarf, bright emerald eyes, with a distinctive, recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. Character identity: a resourceful storyteller and star-reader of the lantern bazaar. Signature costume: a midnight-indigo riding coat over saffron silk layers, gold-trimmed sash, and soft desert boots. Defining personal item: a brass astrolabe pendant and a small lamp-shaped charm. Keep the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and signature item unchanged throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: This theme has one fixed protagonist: preserve the exact character identity in every scene.
Keep the same face, age impression, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, and body proportions.
Keep the signature costume silhouette, materials, colors, and defining personal item consistent; do not randomly redesign the outfit.
Do not replace the protagonist or introduce another lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in domed palace skyline, lantern-hung bazaar, tiled fountain courtyard; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with midnight indigo, saffron, ruby red, emerald; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide shot over rooftops and domes, slow tracking through a crowded bazaar, low glide above sand on a flying carpet; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
